content: Introducing Hacker Papers! I absolutely love this HackerTube idea from @karpathy. So I took his prompt and similar data sources and asked my agent to build the arXiv papers version of it. Absolute bangers there. Find all 1K+ papers here: https://academy.dair.ai/papers/collections/hacker-papers Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5: https://hackertube.org/ - Excellent…
The Computer Science collection is fire! You can also filter by year and sort them.

It's true. Every single person I've told to try Grok Bot: - "Holy fk it's really THAT GOOD" - Starts telling other people to try Grok Bot Try Grok @Bot! You will love it. We land a few dozen fixes, features and sometimes powers to Bot 7 days a week and we look at your feedback to make Bot as perfect as possible.

It seems that I have missed the announcement of the "faster" Astra on October 5th. That would explain why it became nerfed for my research tasks after roughly that day. 🤬 Also, despite many hints and promises, no new SOTA model during this timeframe. Instead we got 6.1 Terra. 🫤 @thsottiaux The end.

This little project does take me back to the days when we were building Papers with Code. We were so obsessed with finding the paper gems through various signals but one of the signals that mattered the most imo is whether people were discussing the paper at all.

Nice to see a successor to GDPval to evaluate AI work but really needs human baselines like GDPval. Funnily enough, GPT-6 Pro spotted some errors in the grading. I also think the 0% scores hide economically meaningful differences in success rates. But still a valuable benchmark! Today we’re releasing GDPx, a benchmark for measuring agentic capabilities across the most valuable domains. GDPx is a true frontier-level benchmark: even the best model scores just 12% (1/7)🧵
